projects.name: win-raccoon
projects.line: Read-only Windows cache audit: 152 measured entries, 9 safety gates, 30.53 GB reclaimed with zero data loss. The engine has no destructive cmdlet, and gate 7 greps its own source to prove it.

projects.name: figma-mcp-plus
projects.line: Figma to code through an 8-stage rule engine — DSL, tree, layout, visual, export — at 98%+ SSIM. The VLM is the fallback, not the method.

toolchain.line: Scans up to 6,000 files and emits 4–10 subagents with per-agent tool allowlists. Zero model tokens spent on the scan.
小浣熊 as a first-class pi provider: OAuth loopback, live model catalog, streaming through pi's own client.
Storyboard preflight, ordered credential failover, resumable downloads, ffmpeg post-production. AIGC video that can be re-run instead of re-bought.
Blind the Infogo MSEP endpoint agent on a workstation, survive reboot, restore on demand. PowerShell, no dependencies.

upstream_note: Merged pull requests only. Two of these are my own repositories; the rest are upstream projects I sent patches to.

now.problem: figma-mcp-plus still falls back to the VLM on deeply overlapping layouts.
now.judgment: The DSL records overlap, overflow and containment but not z-order intent, so the layout stage cannot resolve stacking deterministically.
now.next: Insert an overlap-resolution stage between tree and layout, then measure SSIM on a fixed 20-screen overlap corpus before and after.
